articles.title: Global Maritime Security Summit Reaches Accord on Critical Corridors
articles.titleSo: Shirweynaha Ammniga Baddaha Caalamka oo Lagaga Gaaray Heshiis Istaraatiijiyadeed
articles.summary: World leaders and international maritime organizations ratify new protection standards for key commercial shipping passages.
articles.content: GENEVA — International delegates at the United Nations Maritime Summit have finalized a comprehensive security accord establishing joint protection channels across major global trade routes.
articles.contentSo: GENEVA — Ergooyinka caalamiga ah ee ka qaybgalay Shirweynaha Ganacsiga Baddaha Caalamka ee Geneva ayaa heshiis taariikhi ah ku gaaray hab wada-jir ah oo lagu ilaaliyo marinada ganacsiga caalamiga ah.

articles.title: Somalia Expands Regional Trade Infrastructure & Digital Interbank Network
articles.titleSo: Soomaaliya oo Baddashay Istaraatiijiyadda Ganacsiga Gobolka iyo Isku-Xirka Bangiyada
articles.summary: New commercial agreements aim to boost maritime trade, digital financial platforms, and regional connectivity across East Africa.
articles.content: MOGADISHU — The Federal Government of Somalia, in collaboration with regional trade partners, has officially unveiled a comprehensive framework aimed at expanding maritime commerce and digital financial integration.
articles.contentSo: MUQDISHO — Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyada oo kaashanaysa shirkadaha ganacsiga ee gobolka, ayaa si rasmi ah u daah-furtay hab cusub oo loogu talagalay in lagu ballaariyo ganacsiga badda iyo lacagaha dijiitalka ah.

articles.title: Kenya & Somalia Ratify Border Commerce Protocols and Security Agreements
articles.titleSo: Keniya iyo Soomaaliya oo Mideeyay Heshiisyada Ganacsiga Xadka iyo Ammniga
articles.summary: Bilateral trade discussions streamline agricultural exports, border checkpoints, and joint security patrols.
articles.content: NAIROBI — Bilateral trade discussions between Kenyan and Somali diplomatic delegations reached a milestone agreement in Nairobi.
articles.contentSo: NAIROBI — Shirar taxane ah oo ka dhacay magaalada Nairobi oo ay yeesheen wafuud ka kala socota Keniya iyo Soomaaliya ayaa lagu gaaray heshiis.

articles.title: Horn of Africa Diplomatic Forum Concludes Talks in Addis Ababa
articles.titleSo: Shirkii Diblomaasiyadda Geeska Afrika oo ku Soo Gaba-gaboobay Addis Ababa
articles.summary: Regional ministers address trade routes, transit infrastructure, and diplomatic resolutions during the annual forum.
articles.content: ADDIS ABABA — The annual Horn of Africa Diplomatic Forum concluded in Addis Ababa with regional representatives reaffirming commitments to sovereign dialogue.
articles.contentSo: ADDIS ABABA — Shirweynaha Nabadda iyo Iskaashiga Geeska Afrika oo ka dhacay magaalada Addis Ababa ayaa lagu soo gaba-gabeeyay go'aamo.

articles.title: Djibouti Port Authority Unveils Modernized Shipping & Logistics Terminal
articles.titleSo: Magaalada Jabuuti oo Soo Bandhigtay Xarun Cusub oo Laga Maamulo Dekadaha Badda Cas
articles.summary: Djibouti launches state-of-the-art container tracking and maritime cargo facilities near Bab-el-Mandeb.
articles.content: DJIBOUTI CITY — The Port Authority of Djibouti has officially commissioned a modernized maritime cargo hub equipped with real-time tracking systems.
articles.contentSo: MAGAALADA JABUUTI — Maamulka Dekadaha ee Jabuuti ayaa daah-furay kabayaal casri ah oo loogu talagalay maareynta xamuulka badda cas.

articles.title: Gulf Consortium Directs Clean Energy Capital into Horn Ports
articles.titleSo: Maalgashadayasha Bariga Dhexe oo Maalgelinaya Mashariicda Tamarta Cusboonaata
articles.summary: Consortium commits $450M toward solar arrays, coastal desalination, and cold-chain storage across East Africa.
articles.content: RIYADH — Renewable energy investment firms from Saudi Arabia and the UAE have signed multi-billion dollar framework development agreements.
articles.contentSo: RIYADH — Shirkado waaweyn oo ka socda Saudi Arabia iyo UAE ayaa saxiixay heshiisyo lagu maalgelinayo tamarta qorraxda.
